title: boykopovar/AnyPS5
title_zh: 自动将 PS5 可执行文件移植到 Linux 和 Windows 的工具

paragraphs.en: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
paragraphs.zh: PS5 可执行文件自动移植到 Linux 和 Windows 的工具

paragraphs.en: Tool for automatic executables porting to Linux and Windows.
paragraphs.zh: 用于将可执行文件自动移植到 Linux 和 Windows 的工具。

paragraphs.en: The relinker-only build runs on macOS, including Apple silicon.
paragraphs.zh: 仅重新链接（relinker-only）构建可在 macOS 上运行，包括 Apple 芯片（Apple silicon）。

paragraphs.en: Web converter - files stay on your device.
paragraphs.zh: Web 转换器 - 文件保存在您的设备上。

paragraphs.en: Includes a relinker that converts executable to the target system's native format and implementations of system prx libraries suitable for dynamic linking. No emulation or separate runtime process.
paragraphs.zh: 包含一个重链接器，可将可执行文件转换为目标系统的原生格式，并包含适用于动态链接的系统 prx 库的实现。 无需仿真或单独的运行时进程。

sents.en: Includes a relinker that converts executable to the target system's native format and implementations of system prx libraries suitable for dynamic linking.
sents.zh: 包含一个重链接器，可将可执行文件转换为目标系统的原生格式，并包含适用于动态链接的系统 prx 库的实现。

sents.en: No emulation or separate runtime process.
sents.zh: 无需仿真或单独的运行时进程。

paragraphs.en: Discord , Usage , Build instructions , Architecture , Technical debt of the project , code style conventions , contributing
paragraphs.zh: Discord、用法、构建说明、架构、项目的技术债务、代码风格规范、贡献指南

paragraphs.en: * System libraries: percentage of the functions known to the project so far (declared in core/libs/prx ), not of every PS5 system function. The total grows as more functions are declared.
paragraphs.zh: * 系统库：项目目前已知的函数所占的百分比（在 core/libs/prx 中声明），而非所有 PS5 系统函数。 随着更多函数被声明，该总数会不断增长。

sents.en: * System libraries: percentage of the functions known to the project so far (declared in core/libs/prx ), not of every PS5 system function.
sents.zh: * 系统库：项目目前已知的函数所占的百分比（在 core/libs/prx 中声明），而非所有 PS5 系统函数。

sents.en: The total grows as more functions are declared.
sents.zh: 随着更多函数被声明，该总数会不断增长。

paragraphs.en: Unsupported or unexpected states strictly throw std::runtime_error . what() is printed to stderr and the process terminates.
paragraphs.zh: 不支持或意外的状态会严格抛出 std::runtime_error。what() 会被打印到 stderr，进程随之终止。

paragraphs.en: The shader recompiler successfully produces SPIR-V (validated via Spirv-Tools when built with ANYPS5_ENABLE_SPIRV_TOOLS ).
paragraphs.zh: 着色器重编译器已成功生成 SPIR-V（当使用 ANYPS5_ENABLE_SPIRV_TOOLS 构建时，会通过 Spirv-Tools 进行验证）。

paragraphs.en: Per-game status and test reports live in the Game bring-up discussions, one thread per title.
paragraphs.zh: 各游戏的状态与测试报告位于 Game bring-up（游戏启动）讨论区中，每个游戏一个主题帖。

paragraphs.en: SDL-mapped game controllers are supported, including analog sticks and triggers. Keyboard and mouse controls can be configured with an anyps5-input.ini file. See input mapping for the supported devices and configuration format.
paragraphs.zh: 支持通过 SDL 映射的游戏控制器，包括模拟摇杆和扳机键。 键盘和鼠标控制可以通过 anyps5-input.ini 文件进行配置。 有关支持的设备和配置格式，请参阅输入映射部分。

sents.en: SDL-mapped game controllers are supported, including analog sticks and triggers.
sents.zh: 支持通过 SDL 映射的游戏控制器，包括模拟摇杆和扳机键。

sents.en: Keyboard and mouse controls can be configured with an anyps5-input.ini file.
sents.zh: 键盘和鼠标控制可以通过 anyps5-input.ini 文件进行配置。

sents.en: See input mapping for the supported devices and configuration format.
sents.zh: 有关支持的设备和配置格式，请参阅输入映射部分。
